In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pollen information services are a public good that should be offered to the general public free of charge.
pollen information services are not a self-evident good, but a highly valuable and important public good.
pollen information is a valuable good, which has to be provided with high quality, reliability and accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to be aware of the responsibility of pollen information and the consequences of inadequate information.
pollen data should be evaluated and presented in a way that they are useful and reliable for allergy sufferers.
we have to accept that pollen is a natural part of our environment and we should not try to avoid pollen, but we should be able to cope with pollen.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of pollen data is of utmost importance for the health of allergy sufferers.
the responsibility of institutions providing pollen information has to be defined, and that institutions providing pollen forecasts should be certified.
there is a need to define the quality standards for pollen information services and to certify the institutions involved.
